correctness.rationale: Direct normalized Fourier integration gives Toeplitz Gram [[1,Ax,B(2x²-1)],[Ax,1,Ax],[B(2x²-1),Ax,1]]. Odd/even reflection blocks give 1-y and 1+y/2±sqrt(y²/4+2A²x²); the squared comparison 2x²(A²-B²)>0 proves strict antipodal worst-eigenvalue optimum for every x>0. The defect 4A²z+2B²(2z-1)² is strictly convex over z in [0,cos²ell], with vertex max(0,cos(2ell)/(4cos²ell)). Checking endpoint and Taylor series yields exact threshold, penalty and one-half ratio. Independent calculations directly evaluated six representative widths including ell=pi/4 and confirmed the limiting ratio at four small widths; they are corroborative, not global proof.
